messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: HIGH - inference-gateway-prod-east1 error-rate spike (5xx) - triggered by threshold (error_rate > 5% over 1m). PD: INC-2381. Paging on-call SRE.
alice: acked. I'm oncall. Pulling up dashboards.
ben: i'm coming in, saw a spike on rate-limiter and 502 trend on gateway dashboards. linking perf graphs: https://dashboards.internal/reports/2381 (read-only)
cara: pinging product/support for potential customer impact. any specific customer IDs in error logs?
alice: initial alert shows 5xx concentrated on /v1/generate and /v1/stream endpoints, mostly behind dedicated-pool-east1. latency also up.
dave: I'm seeing a flood of long-running KV cache loads from a subset of requests - high token windows. suspect prefix eviction thrash -> backend overload.
erin: allocs seem saturated on gpu-pool-12, pod restart rate is high. autoscaler didn't kick due to quota.
alice: runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/inference/5xx-spike. First mitigations: 1) enable fallback routing to smaller model-variant, 2) scale dedicated pool or enable burst, 3) throttle offending clients.
ben: I'm going to enable model fallback to redwood-lite-quant on the gateway routing policy. Doing it now.
devops-bot: Action: update-routing policy applied to route inference-prod-west1 -> fallback to redwood-lite-quant, rollout id r-2026-03-14-01
cara: Thanks. I'll check customer impact and open a ticket to CS if any errors are customer-facing.
dave: scaling deployment: running: ```kubectl -n prod scale deployment inference-gateway --replicas=10```
dave: scaling started, pods spinning up (3->10).
alice: also temporarily increase GPU pool capacity: ```gcloud compute instances create gpu-burst-1 --zone=us-east1-b --machine-type=n1-standard-16 --accelerator=type=nvidia-tesla-t4,count=4``` (ops only)
erin: autoscaler limit hit was 8, bumping to 20. submitting change.
ben: fallback applied. error-rate on redwood-lite-quant is low so far. upstream 5xx on the gateway is dropping from 7.3% -> 3.1% over the last 30s.
cara: Support note: no major account spikes yet; a handful of requests from client-id corp-omega saw 502s. CS notified.
alice: good. keep an eye on token throughput. we may need to flush prefix cache for pods that are thrashing. I'll prepare kvcache flush.
dave: kvcache flush command (rolling): ```for pod in $(kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=inference-gateway -o name); do kubectl exec -n prod $pod -- /app/bin/kvcachectl --flush; sleep 2; done```
erin: running kvcache flush now on 2 pods.
ben: monitoring traces: a subset of traces show repeated model load failures leading to 502s: "failed to allocate kv buffer". that aligns with memory pressure.
alice: escalation plan if rate >5% after 10m: failover traffic region -> eu-west1, and enable circuit-breaker to return 503 with retry-after to clients.
cara: I've drafted a customer-first incident banner: "We're experiencing elevated errors and transient failures affecting generation endpoints in us-east. We're actively mitigating and have applied fallbacks. We will update in 15 min." Sending now to status page.
dave: after scaling and fallback, request rate tolerated better. current gateway 5xx = 1.2% last 1m.
alice: recording actions: applied routing fallback, scaled gateway (3->10), increased pool quota, flushed kvcache on thrashing pods, notified CS, posted status page.
erin: will keep autoscaler limit increased for 1 hour.
ben: PD: INC-2381 acknowledged by alice at 2381234570. marking progress notes in PD.
cara: CS confirmed corp-omega minor errors; they will retry. no SLA breaches reported yet.
alice: starting 15m check-in timer. Next update in 10.
incident-bot: Reminder: Please add post-incident summary to #postmortems and link runbook changes.
dave: we should add a guard to prevent kvcache thrash: throttle large prefix loads and reject >X tokens prewarm. filing infra task.
erin: note for oncall handoff: if errors recur, escalate to eng-runtime and reduce keepalive window on LB.
ben: all good for now. continuing to monitor.
alice: handing off to ben at 2381234867 for night coverage. ben, you own until 2381238467.
ben: ack handoff. I'll follow up on infra task and keep PD updated.
cara: closing CS loop: posted to affected customers and monitoring their retries.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-2381 marked as "Monitoring".
